topic: Natural Fluency & Story Narration (Ethiopian Culture & Lakes)
learning_objective: Achieve spoken fluency with connected speech, clear intonation, and native-like flow while narrating stories about Lake Hora, Odaa trees, and community celebrations.
afaan_oromoo_intro_script: Sadarkaa 4ffaa - Qaxalee Fluency! Now speak in English with full sentences, clear rhythm, and natural speed. You are ready!

voice_exercises.app_character_audio_script: Describe the beautiful lake in Bishoftu.
voice_exercises.afaan_oromoo_instruction_script: Fakkii ilaaliitii hima kanaan ibsi: 'The morning sun shines over the lake.'
voice_exercises.expected_speech_target: The morning sun shines over the lake.
voice_exercises.phonetic_guide_for_kids: The MOR-NING SUN SHAINZ OH-VER the LEIK

trouble_phonemes.afaan_oromoo_tip: Jechoota walitti hidhiitii sagalee bareedina qabuun dubbadhu: 'shines over the lake'.

voice_exercises.app_character_audio_script: The great Odaa tree brings our people peace.
voice_exercises.afaan_oromoo_instruction_script: Hima kana ofitti amanammummaan dubbadhu: 'The great Odaa tree brings our people peace.'
voice_exercises.expected_speech_target: The great Odaa tree brings our people peace.
voice_exercises.phonetic_guide_for_kids: The GREIT OH-DAA TREE BRINGZ AWA PEE-PUL PEES

trouble_phonemes.afaan_oromoo_tip: Jechoota 'people' fi 'peace' yommuu dubbattu /p/ qulqullinaan dubbadhu!

voice_exercises.app_character_audio_script: We sing, we dance, and we celebrate together.
voice_exercises.afaan_oromoo_instruction_script: Waliin gammaduufi sirbuu keenya ibsi: 'We sing, we dance, and we celebrate together.'
voice_exercises.expected_speech_target: We sing we dance and we celebrate together.
voice_exercises.phonetic_guide_for_kids: WEE SING WEE DANS AND WEE SEL-E-BREIT TU-GEDH-ER

trouble_phonemes.afaan_oromoo_tip: 'Together' keessatti arraba kee ilkaan jala kaa'i: /ð/!
